blocks.x: Data Analytics & Decision Products from Achala IT Solutions: advisory that ends in a delivered system. The team that recommends is the team that builds — one two-week diagnostic, one signed baseline, delivery under the same gates as every Achala expertise domain.

Data Analytics & Decision Products runs on a fixed rhythm at Achala: a two-week diagnostic that makes the cost visible, a baseline both sides sign, and delivery through the same evidence gates as our platform programs. No advice without ownership of the outcome.

The analytics stack we deliver spans executive reporting, embedded analytics in product surfaces, and the feature stores that feed real-time models, all on one governance fabric, so the number in the board deck, the number in the app, and the number in the model agree.
